import numpy as np, pickle, json, time
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
r=Robot()
OUT='/app/output'
def load():
 return pickle.load(open(OUT+'/obs.pkl','rb'))
def state(o=None):
 return np.array((o or load()).meta['proprio']['now'])
def save(o,label):
 pickle.dump(o,open(OUT+'/obs.pkl','wb'));o.save(OUT+'/'+label)
 print('state',state(o)[:13], 'eef',state(o)[26:29], 'left',o.meta['time_left_s'])
def run(q=None,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,n=40,label='step',mode=-1):
 s=state(); a=np.zeros((n,13));a[:,:7]=np.linspace(s[4:11],s[4:11] if q is None else q,n);a[:,7]=s[36] if grip is None else grip
 if base is not None:a[:,8:11]=base
 a[:,11]=torso;a[:,12]=mode
 np.save(OUT+'/'+label+'_actions.npy',a)
 o=r.submit('joint_position',a,include_depth=True,video='none');save(o,label);return o
origins=[([0,0,.333],[0,0,0]),([0,0,0],[-np.pi/2,0,0]),([0,-.316,0],[np.pi/2,0,0]),([.0825,0,0],[np.pi/2,0,0]),([-.0825,.384,0],[-np.pi/2,0,0]),([0,0,0],[np.pi/2,0,0]),([.088,0,0],[np.pi/2,0,0])]
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 for qi,(p,rp) in zip(q,origins):
  A=np.eye(4);A[:3,3]=p;A[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('xyz',rp).as_matrix();B=np.eye(4);B[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('z',qi).as_matrix();T=T@A@B
 A=np.eye(4);A[2,3]=.2104
 return T@A
if __name__=='__main__':
 print(fk(state()[4:11]))
